顾承安收起手机，在路边的行道树旁靠稳了电动车。

他特意把车停在了夜市入口的路灯下，周围全是出摊的小贩和来来往往的行人，一个停在路边等单的外卖员，混在人堆里半点都不扎眼。

这里离他刚才路过的小卖部已经隔了整整一条街，视线被层层叠叠的握手楼和夜市的摊位挡得严严实实。

别说盯着人了，连小卖部的招牌都看不见。

但他半点不慌，刚才骑车路过的那一眼，已经把周围的地形摸得门儿清——那间小卖部开在城中村主巷的口子上，前门正对着夜市最热闹的步行街，后门直通楼后密密麻麻的窄巷子，巷子宽不过两米，岔路多如牛毛，真要是让他钻进去，想拦都难。

他抬手扯了扯头盔的系带，心里忍不住犯嘀咕。

也亏得这老狐狸能忍，二十六年啊，从二十出头的小伙子熬成了两鬓斑白的小老头，隐姓埋名缩在城中村的小卖部里，愣是没露出半点马脚。

要不是自己今晚瞎溜达，天珠刚好扫到了他的信息，这货指不定真能安安稳稳活到寿终正寝。

想到之前刷到的视频里，那个举着牌子、神智都有些不清的白发老太太，顾承安又开始牙痒痒。

十四个孩子，九个至今没找到，二十多年的时间，多少家庭就这么碎了，这老东西，看起来人模狗样的，真是应了一句话——糟老头子坏得很。

他正琢磨着，眼角余光瞥见两辆不起眼的家用车顺着路边慢慢靠了过来，一前一后停在了他身前几米远的路边。

前头是辆看着有些年头的黑色朗逸，后头跟着辆银灰色的五菱宏光，扔在城中村的车流里，连半点水花都溅不起来，这种情况比警车合适一百倍。

黑色朗逸的驾驶室打开，下来了一个美女——正是苏楠。

她戴了顶黑色的鸭舌帽，长发扎成利落的马尾，穿了件深灰色的T恤，脸上没带妆，却比穿警服的时候多了几分青春洋溢，她一眼就锁定了路灯下的顾承安，快步走了过来。

“顾承安！”她走到近前，用只有两人能听见的声音问道，“目标具体位置在哪？人还在吗？”

Gu Chengan put away his mobile phone and steadied his electric car next to a tree on the side of the road.

He deliberately parked his car under the streetlight at the entrance of the night market, surrounded by vendors and pedestrians. A delivery boy parked on the roadside waiting for his order did not stand out at all among the crowd.

This place is already a whole street away from the canteen he just passed by, and his view is strictly blocked by the layers of handshake buildings and night market stalls.

Not to mention staring at people, you can't even see the sign of the canteen.

But he didn't panic at all. The moment he passed by on his bicycle, he had already figured out the surrounding terrain clearly - the canteen opened at the entrance of the main alley of the village in the city. The front door faced the busiest pedestrian street in the night market, and the back door led directly to the densely packed narrow alley behind the building. The alley was only two meters wide and there were so many forks that it would be difficult for him to get in.

He raised his hand and tugged on the straps of his helmet, unable to help but murmur in his heart.

Fortunately, this old fox could endure it. In twenty-six years, he grew from a young man in his early twenties to a little old man with gray hair on his temples, hiding incognito in a small shop in a village in the city, without revealing any flaws.

If he hadn't been wandering around tonight and Dzi Zhu happened to scan his information, this guy might have been able to live peacefully until the end of his life.

Gu Chengan's teeth started to itch again when he thought of the white-haired old lady who was holding a sign and looking a little confused in the video he had seen before.

Nine of the fourteen children have not been found so far. Over the past twenty years, many families have been broken up. This old guy looks like a dog, and he really lives up to the saying - the bad old man is very bad.

As he was thinking about it, out of the corner of his eye, he saw two inconspicuous family cars approaching slowly along the roadside, and parked on the roadside a few meters in front of him.

In front was a black Lavida that looked quite old, and behind it was a silver-gray Wuling Hongguang. It was thrown into the traffic in the urban village without even a splash of water. This situation was a hundred times more suitable than a police car.

The cab of the black Lavida opened, and a beautiful woman got out - it was Su Nan.

She wore a black peaked cap, her long hair tied into a neat ponytail, and a dark gray T-shirt. There was no makeup on her face, but she was a little more youthful than when she was wearing a police uniform. She locked eyes with Gu Chengan under the streetlight at a glance and walked over quickly.

"Gu Chengan!" She walked closer and asked in a voice that only the two of them could hear, "Where is the specific location of the target? Is he still there?"
